Six things holding your website back

We read your website the way Google does. None of these is hard to fix, and none of them is about speed.

  • 1

    Your website sends callers to a different listing

    Your main Google listing, with 177 reviews, uses (832) 248-4281. Your website shows (281) 377-6093, the number on a second Perfect Painters listing with 4 reviews.

  • 2

    Two Google listings split your reviews

    Searching “Perfect Painters Houston” shows both. Reviews, calls and ranking power are divided between them.

  • 3

    8.4 seconds to load on a phone

    Google’s mobile speed test scored the homepage 42 out of 100. Most people leave before the main image appears.

  • 4

    The same Google description on every page

    Every page says “Call Perfect Painters at 281-377-6093 now…”, so Google sees identical pages.

  • 5

    Four headlines on the homepage

    The slider makes four main headings, repeated, instead of one clear headline.

  • 6

    45 of 45 homepage images Google can’t read

    None of the photos has a description, so your work never shows up in image search.

How long does exterior paint last in Houston? 1. Sun and humidity cut the life of cheap paint to a few years. 2. Good prep (pressure washing, scraping, priming) matters more than the brand. 3. Elastomeric coatings help stucco ride out Houston’s weather. 4. Small cracks and peeling are the time to repaint, before wood rots. Free estimate from Perfect Painters: (832) 248-4281.
